title: Slap Bet
novel:
Barney [[insisted|insist]] that Robin had a [[dark|dark]] secret. "Nobody is that [[mysterious|mysterious]] without a reason," he said. Ted disagreed. So they made a [[slap|slap]] [[bet|bet]] — the [[loser|loser]] would receive one slap, anytime, anywhere, from the winner.

Barney [[investigated|investigate]] Robin like a [[detective|detective]]. He [[dug through|dig through]] her [[purse|purse]], [[interrogated|interrogate]] her [[colleagues|colleague]], and even [[hacked|hack]] into her old [[email|email]]. Eventually, he found a [[videotape|videotape]]. "This will tell us everything," he said, holding it up like a [[trophy|trophy]].

They all [[gathered|gather]] around the TV. The tape started playing... and there was young Robin, dressed in a [[sparkly|sparkly]] [[costume|costume]], singing a [[bubblegum|bubblegum]] pop song called "Let's Go to the [[Mall|Mall]]!" She was "Robin [[Sparkles|Sparkle]]," a Canadian teenager [[pop|pop]] star.

Ted's jaw [[dropped|drop]]. Marshall started laughing so hard he fell off the [[couch|couch]]. Lily [[covered|cover]] her mouth with both hands. Robin stood frozen in the [[corner|corner]], her face as [[red|red]] as a [[tomato|tomato]].

But the secret was not over. The song mentioned something strange — Robin Sparkles was performing at the mall... but why? Then the [[camera|camera]] [[panned|pan]] to the [[mall|mall]] name, and everyone [[gasped|gasp]]. Robin had a second secret, even bigger than the first.

Barney [[raised|raise]] his hand for the slap. "Wait," Ted said. "What is the second secret?"

Robin [[buried|bury]] her face in her hands. "I can't tell you. I just can't."

dark.en: hidden; not known by others; with little light

mysterious.en: difficult to understand or explain; full of secrets

slap.en: a quick hit with the flat part of your hand

bet.en: an agreement to risk money or something on the result of an event

loser.en: a person who is defeated in a competition or bet

investigate.en: to try to find out all the facts about something

detective.en: a person whose job is to discover information about crimes

purse.en: a small bag a woman carries for money and personal items

interrogate.en: to ask someone a lot of questions for a long time

hack.en: to get into someone's computer without permission

email.en: a message sent electronically from one computer to another

videotape.en: an old-style tape for recording video

trophy.en: an object given to the winner of a competition

gather.en: to come together in one place

sparkly.en: shining with many small points of light

costume.en: special clothes worn for a performance or event

bubblegum.cn: 泡泡糖流行乐（轻松流行的）
bubblegum.en: a type of simple, cheerful pop music for young people

mall.en: a large building with many stores inside

sparkle.en: to shine with small points of light

cover.en: to put something over something else to hide or protect it

corner.en: the point where two walls or roads meet

tomato.en: a round red fruit used in cooking

camera.en: a device for taking photographs or recording video

pan.en: (of a camera) to move slowly from one side to another

bury.en: to put something under the ground; to hide your face in your hands
